newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain oil product sales rose 3.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Spain oil product sales rose 3.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Sales of oil products in Spain rose 3.5 percent in 1996, oil traders association AOP said on Wednesday.
The largest increase by product was in gas oil, where sales rose 7.2 percent. Gas oil accounted for half of all fuels consumed in Spain.
Petrol consumption fell 1.4 percent, kerosene rose six percent and fuel oil fell 0.8 percent.

AOP secretary general Aurelio Ayala attributed the rise in the price of crude in the past year to firm world demand, the delay in the return of Iraqi oil to the markets as well as the "just in time" policy employed by large operators.
Ayala said growth in the use of diesel was explained by the fact that it has less tax added to it than petrol.

AOP chairman Eugenio Martin highlighted the growth in petrol consumption, adding that European Union plans to reduce its sulphur content by the year 2000 were unrealistic or required substantial investment.
